text_block_list.name: Haru Urara
text_block_list.text:
Thank you, King-chan! I've grown another 
year older~!

text_block_list.name: Haru Urara
text_block_list.text:
Come to think of it, hey, hey, did you 
know? Rice-chan told me this, but...!

text_block_list.name: Haru Urara
text_block_list.text:
They say cranes live for a thousand years, 
and turtles live for ten thousand~! I 
wanna live just as long as them!

text_block_list.name: King Halo
text_block_list.text:
You're trying to compete with *that*...!? 
W-Well, aiming high is a good thing, I 
suppose.

text_block_list.name: Haru Urara
text_block_list.text:
...Oh, but when you turn 10,000 years old, 
you'll have to blow out 10,000 candles on 
the cake!

text_block_list.name: Haru Urara
text_block_list.text:
I wonder if I can blow them all out 
alone~? King-chan, would you help me blow 
out the candles?

text_block_list.name: King Halo
text_block_list.text:
"...Huh? Help out, as in... with all 
10,000 candles...?"

text_block_list.name: Haru Urara
text_block_list.text:
Let's practice right now! Here goes~... 
*Phew*!!
